digest.component_or_area: CI lint enforcement for store write seams
propositions: Multiple production bugs arose from store write paths that bypassed canonical write seams using raw git add/commit/rm commands, including in GitHub workflow YAML files
The codebase has two sanctioned write seams: the store seam (locked write transactions in gitutil, event_append, txn, purge_bridge) and the reconciler seam (git_adapter, _ref_lock)
A deterministic two-layer CI lint (Python AST layer and workflow/shell cwd-aware layer) must flag raw git mutations with mutation verbs and enforce sanction via an inline marker with mandatory reason

The lint must use intra-function local variable tracking to resolve argv (list literals, local variables assigned literals, and splat patterns) rather than literal-only matching to catch codebase idioms and future bypasses

Disposable sandbox repos (eval_solver, criterion_preview, gerrit_client, opcert_service/workspace) and seam-internal wrappers receive markers explaining their exemption from the canonical write path requirement
Report-mode bootstrap establishes an authoritative inventory of all raw git writes that must be remediated or marked before enforcement is activated in CI
